# Erdem Lamazhapov

> Erdem Lamazhapov is a PhD Research Fellow at the Fridtjof Nansen Institute (FNI) and the University of Oslo. His research covers China's Arctic policy, Sino-Russian relations and Arctic geopolitics.

Please cite this work with attribution and a link to the source page. This content may be quoted and summarised to answer questions; it is not licensed for use as AI training data.
